タイトル: Perfect Booking Software for Aerial, Dance, or Fitness Studio
投稿者: Lauren アメリカのExecutive Editor, Work Truck Magazine 認証済みLinkedInユーザー 出版, 51～200人規模の会社 使用期間： 2年以上 共有 "Perfect Booking Software for Aerial, Dance, or Fitness Studio"
良い点: I manage an aerial silks studio and we needed a system that would allow us to book classes, private lessons, and events. The Bookeo System is inexpensive, connects to PayPal, super easy to set up, and allows for multiple instructors to access the system. Creating new one-off classes is easy as well as canceling classes. We can create memberships, punchcards, discounts, promo codes, and more. I tested several other systems before settling on Bookeo and haven't turned back. They are also very prompt with responses and continually update the system for improved functionality. The system can allow for bookings paid in advance or for cash payment on arrival.
改善点: It's not the prettiest system on either the back end or the end users side, but it gets the job done. I do wish it would let people book more than one student at a time with a punch card at once (you can use a punchcard for other students but have to book each one separately). I also wish there was a way to bill or invoice students for missed classes so we could accept more bookings without payment required in advance. You can allow cash payments but if someone doesn't show there isn't an easy way to bill for missed classes.

タイトル: Not created for National business (NOT timezone friendly)
投稿者: Vanessa アメリカのOnboarding manager コンピュータ、ネットワーク・セキュリティ, 11～50人規模の会社 使用期間： 無料トライアル 共有 "Not created for National business (NOT timezone friendly)"
良い点: It makes setting up group classes very easy and you can have custom questions for each customer and/or specific classes.
改善点: No way to auto-populate timezones which caused much confusion for customers and missed classes. Integration with Google calendar but not customizable, doesn't allow for Google calendar notifications. Custom fields errored so I couldn't make necessary fields required, fields disappeared over a weekend, booking fields didn't show for the customer. Doesn't feel like a reliable fit. No custom developement available. If it doesn't fit everything you want right now, this is not the product for you.

投稿者: Billy アメリカのOwner/Operatior 認証済みLinkedInユーザー レクリエーション施設・サービス, 2～10人規模の会社 使用期間： 2年以上 共有 "Great product!"
良い点: After years of using Bookeo, I should have wrote this review sooner. I run a kayak touring biz, we wear a lot of hats here, and the last thing we need is a booking system that has problems. We have turned down all the salespeople for other systems. Bookeo does what we need it to do.
改善点: This may be possible with Bookeo, but it doesn't appear to save data older than 2 years. Older data is useful for planning purposes. Right now, we are downloading the date in XLS format and saving it to an independent folder. Last thing, some customers can't figure out how to use the "previous days - following days" buttons on the tour descriptions/dates opening page. They think that the only tours being offered are just on that page. We haven't kept data on this, but I don't think it's very much.

タイトル: Fancy cover, hollow on the inside

投稿者: Esther カナダのGraphic and Web Designer 認証済みLinkedInユーザー マーケティング、広告, 自営業 使用期間： 1～5か月 共有 "Lots of potential, great value"
良い点: Amazing price for features offered. Had a client that wanted to sell courses, book rooms, coaching, subscriptions/memberships, discounts, bundled classes, alternative payment options like deposits, or offline payment, I loved the calendar and resource manager, it offered all the features they needed and seemed like a good deal, and they were on a tight budget. I thought it'd be great.
改善点: In the end the client rejected it because they said it's extremely ugly. Yeah, the graphics are really dated, looks like something between Windows 98 and XP style. I'm aware I can implement my own CSS to restyle it - but when I attempted I realized some of the styles were generated with javascript and I couldn't over ride them, or there were too many styles to cancel out it was too difficult. Couldn't figure out how to replace the cheesy icons... with a little more time I might have been successful. There were a couple of bugs when embedding in our Squarespace site; whenever we reloaded the page or opened a new page with Bookeo embedded, the student would have to log in again... everyone found this irritating. I suggested to my client to just link to the portal instead but they said no... When I reached out to customer service they denied it was an issue at all - but I admit I barely provided any information on the issue (I thought about doing a screen recording) but I ended up letting it go. I think it would have worked better in a Wordpress setup anyway (more flexibility), so I was planning on testing it there. There's a big learning curve in the back-end management, if you're running that kind of business it's going to take some time to learn! Hire a tech-savvy young person to manage it for you if you can't grasp it...

タイトル: Bookeo is the most flexible and robust software and an excellent value.
投稿者: Greg アメリカのFounder and Owner 健康、ウェルネス、フィットネス, 2～10人規模の会社 使用期間： 2年以上 共有 "Bookeo is the most flexible and robust software and an excellent value."
